files.author: Pedro Szekely from Los Angeles, USA
files.caption:
A view of the strand in El Porto, in Los Angeles, California.

ISO 100, 21mm, f9, (1/10, 1/2, 1.6) on tripod. HDR processed in Photomatix and tonemapped using Details Enhancer. Imagenomic noise reduction, smart sharpen, curves for contrast, soft light layer for more contrast. The Nik Silver Efex conversion to BW selecting a high contrast present.
